title: Brik Pipeline Env v1
description: Contract for the .brik-logs/pipeline.env file written by the init stage of the execution notion (lib/pipeline/pipeline-env.sh) and consumed by every downstream stage through dotenv propagation (GitLab artifacts.reports.dotenv, Jenkins stash, local sourcing). v1 captures the 20 mandatory keys currently observed on the the test campaign campaign (7/7 samples, identical structure). To validate a pipeline.env file against this schema, convert KEY=VALUE lines to a JSON object first (the file format is dotenv, not JSON).

BRIK_GIT_USER_EMAIL.description: Email of the git user that triggered the pipeline. Used by the release stage for tag annotations.

BRIK_GIT_USER_NAME.description: Display name of the git user. Used by the release stage for tag annotations.

BRIK_PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name resolved from brik.yml project.name. Used as default tag/image name when no other source is set.

BRIK_BUILD_STACK.description: Stack id resolved by stacks.<id>.detect or stated in brik.yml project.stack.

BRIK_BUILD_STACK_VERSION.description: Stack version (e.g. '22' for Node 22, '3.13' for Python). Drives runner image selection.

BRIK_CI_IMAGE.description: Resolved CI image for the build stage. Pattern: registry/name:tag.

BRIK_IMG_STACK.description: Runner image for stack-class stages (build, lint, test).

BRIK_IMG_BASE.description: Runner image for base-class stages (init, release, notify).

BRIK_IMG_SCANNER.description: Runner image for scanner-class stages (scan, container-scan).

BRIK_IMG_DEPLOY.description: Runner image for deploy-class stages (deploy, promote).

BRIK_RELEASE_PROFILE.description: Git workflow profile resolved from brik.yml .release.profile. Mirrors planning's release.profile enum.

BRIK_PROJECT_VERSION.description: Project version derived from the latest git tag (stripped of .release.tag_prefix). Falls back to 0.0.0 when no tag exists.

BRIK_IS_CANDIDATE.description: Dotenv-encoded boolean. '1' when the current commit is a release candidate, '0' otherwise. Mirrors planning's release.is_candidate.

BRIK_PACKAGE_ENABLED.description: Dotenv-encoded boolean. 'true' when the package stage is enabled by planner gate, 'false' otherwise.

BRIK_DEPLOY_ENABLED.description: Dotenv-encoded boolean. 'true' when the deploy stage is enabled (BRIK_WITH_DEPLOY opt-in), 'false' otherwise.

BRIK_TEST_REPORTS_ENABLED.description: Dotenv-encoded boolean. 'true' when test reports collection is enabled.

BRIK_TEST_COVERAGE_FORMAT.description: Coverage report format expected by the test stage. 'auto' lets the stack-specific test runner pick a default.

BRIK_TEST_COVERAGE_DIR.description: Relative path where the test stage writes the coverage report.

BRIK_TEST_JUNIT_PATH.description: Relative path where the test stage writes the JUnit XML report.
